one_liner_zh: 科林研發EPS超預期、營收年增23.76%，晶圓設備需求回升。
one_liner_en: Lam Research beats EPS with 23.76% revenue growth on recovering equipment demand.
beat_or_miss: 超預期：EPS驚喜+7.87%，營收年增23.76%，記憶體與先進製程設備暢旺。
ai_view_zh: 訊號正向：EPS超預期、營收年增23.76%，AI帶動的記憶體與先進製程擴產使蝕刻沉積設備龍頭受惠。短中期股價由HBM/DRAM資本支出循環驅動，先進封裝提升單位設備價值為結構性利多。追蹤指標：記憶體客戶資本支出計畫、HBM相關設備訂單、出口管制政策、服務業務占比。設備股具週期性，須以資本支出循環位置判斷；73倍本益比仰賴景氣上行延續，須警惕循環見頂風險。
ai_view_en: Signal positive: EPS beat and 23.76% revenue growth, with AI-driven memory and advanced-node expansion benefiting the etch/deposition leader. Near to mid-term, the stock is driven by the HBM/DRAM capex cycle, while advanced packaging raising per-tool value is a structural positive. Track: memory-customer capex plans, HBM-related equipment orders, export-control policy, and service-revenue mix. Equipment stocks are cyclical, so gauge the capex-cycle position; a 73x P/E depends on the upcycle persisting, so watch for cycle-peak risk.
highlights_zh: EPS 1.47美元，超出預期1.36美元，驚喜幅度7.87%。
營收58.4億美元，年增23.76%，設備需求顯著回升。
記憶體（HBM/DRAM）擴產帶動蝕刻與沉積設備需求。
先進封裝與3D架構提升設備複雜度與單位價值。
服務業務（CSBG）提供穩定經常性收入。
highlights_en: EPS of $1.47 beat the $1.36 estimate by 7.87%.
Revenue of $5.84B grew 23.76% YoY on a notable equipment-demand recovery.
Memory (HBM/DRAM) expansion drives etch and deposition demand.
Advanced packaging and 3D architectures raise equipment complexity and value.
Service business (CSBG) provides stable recurring revenue.
risks_zh: 半導體設備具週期性，需求易隨資本支出循環波動。
出口管制限制對特定市場的銷售。
本益比73.94倍，估值反映高週期景氣預期。
risks_en: Semiconductor equipment is cyclical, swinging with capex cycles.
Export controls limit sales to certain markets.
A P/E of 73.94 reflects high cyclical-upturn expectations.
